description: hooks/lib/corpus_what_comments.jsonl has 49 rows and none with a subject opener ("The reader votes a sentence, so ..."). T-013 measured variants (a) and (b) at the same precision 0.6944, because the corpus cannot tell them apart. Variant (a) blocks 8/8 subject-opener narrations, but it also blocks 6/8 genuine WHY lines with a subject opener. Add labelled subject-opener rows for both classes. Then look for a rule that separates narration from a genuine reason with a subject, without reopening the escape. Report precision and recall before and after. Found by the T-013 agent on 2026-10-05.
title: Measure the subject-opener rule with corpus rows
